'''Teef Lan Cody''' was the father of the [[Chief medical officer]] aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], [[Zahara Cody]]. He was in a relationship with the [[Zahara Cody's mother|mother]] of his child. He was sent a letter by his child saying that Teef had been correct about something and that Zahara would return home and join an [[unidentified organization]]. Zahara also wrote a second, shorter letter telling him of a [[Plague|medical situation]] aboard ''Purge'' that was killing several people, causing chaos through the barge and driving some to [[Death/Legends|suicide]].It resulted in turning them into literal zombies. She stated that isolation and quarantine had no effect to the virus and that she felt it only a matter of [[Time/Legends|time]] before she became infected as well. The letters were recovered aboard ''Purge'' after its occupants were decimated by a plague, so it is unlikely that they reached him before it was released to the public for academic purposes in relation to the history of ''Purge''.
